target_hypothesis: The V0.13 same-profile hosted-job response spread is generated by repeated identical solver construction within one hosted runner/process, rather than solely by cross-job/runner environmental variation.
object: Within-profile pairwise relative spread of the signed centered beta response (plus-minus)/(2h) across three sequential identical CLASS solver sequences in one Python process, evaluated only on the exact V0.13 diagnostic cells.

pre_registered_decision.PASS: If all invariants and anchors pass and at least one REPLAY_FAILURE cell has within-profile max pairwise spread >=1e-5 across the three sequential identical repeats, classify SAME_RUN_REPEATED_SOLVER_NONDETERMINISM_SUPPORTED. This supports a within-run solver/process-state reproducibility defect only and authorizes a separately frozen solver-state/initialization/memory/parallel-reduction localization audit.
pre_registered_decision.FAIL: If all invariants and anchors pass and every REPLAY_FAILURE cell in both profiles has within-profile max pairwise spread <1e-5, classify SAME_RUN_REPEATED_SOLVER_DETERMINISM_SUPPORTED. The V0.13 nondeterminism is then scoped to cross-job/runner variation and only a prospectively frozen host-environment fingerprint reproducibility audit is authorized.
pre_registered_decision.BLOCKED: If any anchor repeat spread reaches 1e-5, requested-node binding exceeds 1e-12, a required lane/repeat is missing, or finite-value controls fail, classify SAME_RUN_SOLVER_DETERMINISM_AUDIT_INCONCLUSIVE and authorize no scientific promotion.
pre_registered_decision.INVALID: Any identity/hash mismatch, changed frozen numerical input, changed threshold, or unauthorized downstream read invalidates the execution and cannot be repaired by changing the scientific contract after results.

interpretation_ceiling: V0.14 may localize the V0.13 reproducibility defect to within-run solver/process behavior or to cross-job/runner behavior. It cannot validate full Layer-B, covariance, whitening, nuisance treatment, relation-null, Wm_S3, global traversal, dark-sector inference, or any physical signal claim.
